title: Validate an asset register, row by row
heading: Pydantic Converts Each Field at the Boundary, or Says Why It Cannot
cases: valid rows come back as assets whose fields have their real types
a row with a negative age is rejected, naming the age field
an asset of age zero is valid
a Weibull shape of zero is rejected
a blank Weibull scale is rejected, not taken as unknown
a consequence of failure written as "1,800" is rejected, not repaired
a remaining life of 2.5 years is rejected
a region outside the four allowed names is rejected
